reported_measurements.grid_height_source: User correction, 2026-11-19: grid, grey surround and thin black outline are 20 mm above the table; outer black border is 1 mm lower, at 19 mm. With 3 mm feet, body thickness to the border is derived as 16 mm.

printed_cell_measurements.black_line_extra_interpretation: User reports each black boundary line is 0.45 mm wide, on each side; relation to colour widths and nominal pitch remains unverified.
printed_cell_measurements.note: First/second direction retain the original measurement labels (Y/X). Dimensions elsewhere are now X/Y. Approximate ruler spans and visible colour widths are retained separately from logical cell pitch.

reported_measurements.seam_effect_reported: The a1-to-a8 (Y) direction crosses the seam.

surface.basis: User confirms the opened board is flat enough; the seam does not change flatness

marker_corner_order: Canonical decoded marker order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left; not image-sorted

corner_order_evidence.method: Marker decoding and board orientation checked; canonical corner ordering verified.

notes: Measured marker geometry and decoded corner ordering are recorded. Camera intrinsic calibration and held-out validation have not been performed; no calibration consumer is connected yet.
Dimension arrays use X/Y: a1-to-h1 then a1-to-a8. The original first/second printed-width labels correspond to Y/X.
Measure the outer black marker boundary, not the paper or tape edge. Include marker placement and rotation; do not assume it is centred in a square.
A taped-marker chessboard is treated as a custom target unless a standard ChArUco corner/ID layout is explicitly verified.

Grid dimensions are X/Y = 202/198 mm; nominal pitches are X/Y = 25/24.5 mm. Y-direction W-B-W widths sum to 73.1 mm, matching the reported span. X-direction B-W-B widths sum to 75.8 mm versus an approximately 76 mm span. Preserve ruler measurements without forcing exact pitch; seam inclusion conventions and decoded corner order remain to be verified; seam location is confirmed between ranks 4 and 5.
Body plus feet gives the outer black border height: 16 + 3 = 19 mm. Grid and grey surround are at 20 mm. Board-frame Z remains zero at the playing surface.

All 40 board-relative corners are preserved exactly as supplied. Canonical coordinates are enabled only for markers with corner_order_verified=true. Remaining markers must be excluded from calibration until verified. Do not force measured quadrilaterals to perfect squares.

marker_identity_source.reason: Existing coordinates derive from manual pixel references and nominal 26 mm cell spacing, not independently measured physical marker corners.

marker_measurements.precision_interpretation: User estimate, not a statistical standard deviation
marker_measurements.corner_labels: Board-relative TL/TR/BR/BL when a1 is bottom-left and h1 bottom-right; distinct from decoded marker order
marker_measurements.surface_z_basis: Planar target assumption, not a measured tape thickness
